title: Near and Far
subtitle: Storytelling Adventure & Atlas Campaign
tagline: Recruit companions, pack your gear, and search for the mythical Last Ruin across an illustrated atlas.
loreSummary: Four wanderers search for the Last Ruin, a city that holds an artifact capable of granting the deepest desires of the heart. Journey across an atlas of illustrated maps, read encounters from a massive storybook, build camps, and manage your pack birds and adventurers.
roadmapTitle: Atlas Journey to the Last Ruin
keyFeatures: Sequel to Above and Below, set in Ryan Laukat's enchanting fantasy world of Arzium
Atlas of 11 full-color illustrated map boards featuring unique terrain and branching story paragraphs
Character mode with dedicated quest cards exploring each adventurer's personal story and motivation
Combines worker placement, resource management, and rich choose-your-own-path storytelling

near_and_far_story_campaign.name: The Search for the Last Ruin (10 Atlas Sessions)
near_and_far_story_campaign.description: The definitive campaign arc traveling across 10 sequential atlas maps to unlock the final secrets of the Last Ruin.

near_and_far_character_quest.name: Personal Character Quest Arc (4 Sessions)
near_and_far_character_quest.description: A focused 4-session journey following personal character quests and specific narrative milestones.

near_and_far_arcade_mode.name: Full Atlas Completionist (All 11 Maps & Mines)
near_and_far_arcade_mode.description: An exhaustive expedition playing through every single map in the atlas plus the subterranean mine challenges.

milestones.title: Leaving Hope's End
milestones.description: Setting camp and recruiting pack birds and adventurers for the trek into uncharted lands.

milestones.title: The Sunken Sands
milestones.description: Surviving brutal sandstorms and discovering buried obsidian shrines in the deep dunes.

milestones.title: The Highland Crossing
milestones.description: Scaling treacherous mountain passes and encountering enigmatic mountain tribes and ancient ruins.

milestones.title: Whispering Swamp
milestones.description: Navigating dense bayous and uncovering the key artifacts pointing toward the legendary sanctuary.

milestones.title: The Last Ruin Found
milestones.description: Reaching the mythical Last Ruin, unlocking the final story paragraph, and fulfilling your traveler's ultimate quest.
